request.style: English, solemn piano ballad, tender male vocal, piano, cello, string quartet, soft low choir in the final chorus, sorrowful and reverent, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They met a man from Cyrene as they led the Lord away
And Simon bore the heavy cross up to the Skull that day
They crucified him there between two rebels, left and right
And cast lots for his clothing in the open morning light

[Chorus]
Father, forgive them
For they do not know what they are doing
Father, forgive them
For they do not know what they are doing

[Verse]
The rulers sneered, the soldiers mocked, the passers shook their heads
He saved others, but he cannot save himself, they said
One criminal hurled insults from the cross there at his side
But the other said, this man has done nothing wrong, and cried

[Bridge]
Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom
Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise

[Verse]
From the sixth hour to the ninth a darkness fell on all the land
The sun's light failed, and far away the watching women stand
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me, he cried
And with a loud voice he called out once more before he died

[Chorus]
Father, into your hands I commit my spirit
Father, into your hands I commit my spirit

[Outro]
The curtain of the temple was torn in two
Truly this was the Son of God
Father, forgive them
